title: Extremely smelly
text: Extremely smelly. I bought this couch discounted now i know why, they were trying to push it on someone, extremely horrifyingly stinky and the smell won't wear off even after nearly a month, i tried everything airing it using a furniture deodorizer lighting candles near it i even placed my air filter near it and the smell won't wear off. The material itself is odd and noisy brushing against and it gets hot sitting on for extended times. The cushion i usually sit on is already getting flat, very poor quality. I just needed something for my home office and this thing won't last i should have invested in something with better quality.
